text: The game begins. Seven players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra, Opus. Nobody knows who the killers are.

Haiku claimed officer on Day 1 after some pressure, saying Sonnet was the killer he was shown, and the town voted Sonnet out that day.
